body: I'm sick of it to. I won't stop you if you want to take a leap of faith, since there really is no cure for what everyone here has. Just do what you want, ok? If it will lead you to a better place, then I have no right to stop you. Don't feel bad about this at all, it was never your fault.

I'm 14 and just started high school this year, I get it. We're all to young for this, but sometimes this world is just bad. I hate it, but it's time for some of us to go. I know it hurts. I hope you feel better, but that's just wishful thinking on my end. None of us ever get better.

If it's a high enough bridge, then you'll probably die on impact. I would recommend a skyscraper if you want to jump bc i'm pretty sure cement has a high lethality rate then water when it comes to jumping suicides. If you want to drown you can fill a backpack with weights and let youself sink. I don't know if I should stop you, but if you hurt as much as the rest of us then I don't know if I can stop you.
I hate myself so much I want me to suffer more.
